Features

The WordPress you know, on a brand-new engine.

Keep your themes, plugins and dashboard; run fewer servers and do less maintenance.

One binary

Installation is a single file. No PHP-FPM, Nginx or extra services needed.

PostgreSQL + JSONB

JSONB instead of meta tables; queries are indexed and backups get simpler.

WASM plugins

Plugins run in a signed sandbox and can never crash the site.

Built-in page builder

Drag, drop, publish with Golementor. Without a single line of code.

Task runner

Scheduled tasks run in the background without cron.

Page cache

Frequently visited pages stay in memory; responses in milliseconds.
